protocol.parameter_units: q is scalar log-rate variance per transition, phi^2 times coefficient-space drift_scale
protocol.fixed_parameters: Known initial mean/variance and kappa2; only per-neuron q is optimized
protocol.objective: Selected Laplace evidence, full-sequence Adam(0.01), shared SGD mixin
protocol.direct_search: 241 log-spaced scales on [1e-10,30], sampled local maxima refined; includes exact zero and endpoints
protocol.optimization_check: Objective gap <=0.001 nat against direct search; outside-bound fits reported
protocol.timing: Descriptive wall-clock including first-call compilation; not a performance comparison
protocol.limitation: Short scalar, model-matched datasets with known nuisance parameters; no full spatial joint-learning claim
